verdict.rationale: The CLI is distributed through GitHub releases, and hands-on users report installing rcli via Homebrew and an install script, so prebuilt distribution exists. However, the docs in this pack never describe package installs, and users report that the Homebrew install does not load everything properly, that the install script silently installs Homebrew, and that rcli segfaults. missing for 10: first-party documentation of binary/package install channels (Homebrew, npm/SPM/Maven for the SDKs), evidence that packaged installs work reliably across platforms.
